content: Yooseefey Birshida Agumo
Guuththa wodeppe guye Gibxe kawo ushshu duuqqizayta alaafeynne quma kaththizayta alaafey ba godaa Gibxe kawo qohida.
Kawoy ushshu duuqqizayta halaqanne quma kaththizayta halaqata nam7ata bolla keehi hanqettides.
Hessa gishshas zabeta halaqaza keeththan Yooseefey qashettida woyne keeththan yeggides.
Zabeta halaqay istta Yooseefes sheedhdhiin izi isttas koshshiza miishshan maaddides; isttika qasho keeth gelidi guuth gam7ida mala,
Gibxe kawos ushshu duuqqizayta halaqaynne quma kaththizayta halaqay, nam7ayka qasho keeththan dishe issi qamma omars baas baas agumo agumettida. Nam7ata agumo birsheththika dumma dumma.
Yooseefey maalado isttako gelida wode istti muuzotti uttidayta be7ides.
Hessa gishshas ba godaa qasho keeththan banara diza kawo oosanchchata, «Hach intte ayfesoy aazas dhumidee?» gi oychchides.
Isttika izas, «Nuni nam7ay agumo agumettidos; gido attiin nuus birshiza asi dhaydes» gida. Yooseefeykka isttas, «Agumo birshizay Xoossa gidennee? Intte agumoza ane taas yootite» gides.
Histtiin ushshu duuqqizayta halaqay ba agumo Yooseefes, «Tani ta agumon issi woyne mith ta sinththan dizayssa be7adis.
Qasse he woyne miththaas heedzdzu haggay dees. Heerakka aacada ciiyadus; lo7eththa wurcada ayfadus.
He wode Paaroone ushshaa xuu7ay ta kushen dees; tanikka woyneza ayfe maxada xuu7aza giddon gum7ada ushshaa Paaroones immadis» gi yootides.
Histtiin Yooseefeykka zaaridi, «Hessa birsheththi hayssa; heedzdzu haggati heedzdzu gallassata.
Heedzdzu gallassata giddon kawoy nena denththidi izi nena kase ne diza alaafeteththan woththana; kase neni ushshu duuqqiza wode ooththida mala neni kawo wancaa iza kushen woththana.
Gido attiin nees wodey lo7ida wode tana baloppa; taaska kiya; ta gishshas kawos yootada ha qasho keeththaafe tana kesisa;
gaasoykka tana Ibraaweta biittafe wolqqara shammi ehida; gido attiin hayssaththo tana qashos gaththiza miish aykkoka ooththabeekke» gides.
Kath kaththizayta halaqay Yooseefey ushshu duuqqizayta agumo lo7eththi birshidayssa be7idi Yooseefes, «Tanikka agumo agumettadis; hessika, ‹Ta hu7en heedzdzu masoobe tookka oykkadis.
Bolla bagga masooben Gibxe kawos uukettida dumma dumma qumay dees. Gido attiin kafoti hessa ta hu7en diza masoobezappe mida› » gi yootides.
Histtiin Yooseefey, «Hessa birsheththay hayssa; heedzdzu masoobeti heedzdzu gallassata.
Heedzdzu gallassata giddon kawoy nena denththidi ne qoodhe muucidi miththa bolla kaqisana; ne ashokka kafoti maana» gides.

Heedzdzanththo gallas Gibxe kawoy ba yelettida gallas ba kawoteththan diza shuumeta ubbaas gibira giigsides. Ushshu duuqqizayta halaqanne kath kaththizayta halaqaa qasho keeththaafe kessidi ba shuumeta sinththan essides.
Ushshu duuqqizayta halaqaza kase iza shuumeteththan zaariin izi kawo kushen wanca woththides.
Gido attiin kawozi kath kaththizayta halaqaa Yooseefey iza agumo birshida mala iza kaqisides.
Ushshu duuqqizayta halaqay gidikko Yooseefe qoppontta dogi aggides.
